top_categories.workout_context: 101ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At mile 60 of 138, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Levi's GranFondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.

Road-specific control matters at Levi's GranFondo. Practice on paved Sonoma County roads: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 138 miles.
At Levi's GranFondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Levi's GranFondo. Train it until it feels boring.
14,000ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
14,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 14,000ft of climbing on paved Sonoma County roads does to your power file on race day.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Levi's GranFondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 138 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
138 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Levi's GranFondo’s 138 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Levi's GranFondo rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved sonoma county roads to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Durability, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 138 miles of paved sonoma county roads in Windsor, Sonoma County, California, USA (relocated from Santa Rosa in 2022).
